description: Nivolumab is recommended as an option for treating locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults after chemotherapy, only if: their tumours are PD-L1 positive, and it is stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment, or earlier if their disease progresses, and they have not had a PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor before. It is recommended only if the company provides nivolumab according to the commercial arrangement.

extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended nivolumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer in adults after chemotherapy, whose tumours are PD-L1 positive, when they have not had a PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor before and treatment is stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment or earlier if disease progresses. Nivolumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
